reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: clause 12.3 expressly disclaims any exclusivity, non-compete, MFC or minimum-volume commitment by Customer, and clause 2.1 confirms no minimum quantity or purchase commitment and that declining further Order Forms is not a breach — this meets the preferred position (no exclusivity binding Customer).
The only exclusivity-flavoured restraint (12.4) runs against Vendor and benefits Customer, correctly noted as not a deviation per the detection guidance.

No redline or counterparty comment was proposed, which is the expected output for a compliant finding; the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraphs and the deterministic check confirms no sole-supplier/requirements obligation remains.
